provenance.seed_rule: game i uses seed BASE_SEED + i for every variant (paired CRN)
provenance.seat_rule: on the play iff seed % 4 == 0 (one seat in four)
provenance.trials: states: per-variant goldfish games with snapshots; synthetic: per-cell samples
provenance.not_a_win_rate: All probabilities are availability of a deterministic line if no opponent interacts.

definition.win_draws: library cards that, added to hand now, give a deterministic win this window
definition.piece_draws: winning draws that are not tutors (the card is used as a line piece/mana/enabler)
definition.tutor_draws: winning draws that are tutors (tutor-equivalent outs)
definition.protected_draws: winning draws whose line can be shielded or counter-backed
definition.nondet_draws: draws that only enable a nondeterministic finish (Finale X>=10 combat)
definition.instant windows: timing=instant: opponents' turns, untapped resources only, flash enablers required
definition.already_winning: state has a deterministic line before drawing (CSA counted only for non-winning states)
